---
title: "EO missions"
---

EO data spans a range of modalities and thematic focuses, presenting distinct trade-offs in spatial detail, temporal revisit, and access regimes. To ground the subsequent discussion of processing baselines and retrieval pipelines, @tbl-eo-missions establishes a concrete taxonomy of the missions that recur most often in large-scale mapping, covering both open-access constellations and commercial platforms, alongside their core specifications and typical applications.

| **Mission** | **Modality** | **Spatial res.** | **Revisit** | **Cov.** | **Active** | **Typical use cases** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| *Open access* | | | | | | |
| Sentinel-2 | Optical | 10–60 m | 5 days | 🌿 | 2015– | Land cover, agriculture |
| Landsat | Optical | 15–120 m | 8–18 days | 🌿 | 1972– | Land cover change |
| Sentinel-3 | Optical | 300–1200 m | <2 days | 🌐 | 2016– | Ocean color, SST |
| MODIS | Optical | 250–1000 m | 1–2 days | 🌐 | 1999– | Vegetation, fire, albedo |
| VIIRS | Optical | 375–750 m | $\sim 1$ day | 🌐 | 2011– | Nighttime lights, fire |
| Sentinel-1 | SAR, C-band | 5–20 m | 6 days | 🌐<sup>\*</sup> | 2014– | Flood, oil spill mapping |
| ALOS PALSAR/-2 | SAR, L-band | 6–100 m | 14–46 days | 🌐 | 2006– | Forest mapping |
| NISAR | SAR, L/S-band | 10–20 m | 12 days | 🌿 | 2026– | Land, forest, ice change |
| BIOMASS | SAR, P-band | 50–200 m | $\sim 17$ days | 🌿 | 2025– | Forest biomass |
| GEDI | LiDAR | 25 m footprint | Sparse | ±51.6° | 2019– | Canopy height, biomass |
| ICESat-2 | LiDAR | 11 m footprint | 91 days | 🌐 | 2018– | Ice sheet elevation |
| GRACE / GRACE-FO | Gravimetry | $\sim 300$ km | 30 days | 🌐 | 2002– | Groundwater, ice mass |
| Gaofen-1/6<sup>†</sup> | Optical | 16 m | 2–4 days | 🌐 | 2013– | Agriculture, land cover |
| *Commercial* | | | | | | |
| Planet (Dove) | Optical | 3–5 m | Daily<sup>‡</sup> | 🌿 | 2017– | Change detection |
| Planet (SkySat) | Optical | 0.5 m | 🎯 | 🎯 | 2016– | Sub-daily site monitoring |
| Vantor (WorldView) | Optical | 0.3–2 m | 🎯 | 🎯 | 2001– | Change detection, defense |
| Airbus (Pléiades/SPOT) | Optical | 0.3–6 m | 🎯 | 🎯 | 2002– | Large-area mapping, 3D |
| ICEYE | SAR, X-band | 0.25–3 m | 🎯 | 🎯 | 2018– | Flood, disaster response |
| Capella | SAR, X-band | 0.5–1.2 m | 🎯 | 🎯 | 2020– | Infrastructure monitoring |
| TerraSAR-X / TanDEM-X | SAR, X-band | 1–18 m | 11 days | 🎯 | 2007– | Elevation models, InSAR |
: Earth observation missions that recur in large-scale mapping. Revisit times assume full constellation availability; spatial resolution ranges reflect different acquisition modes or spectral bands. Coverage: 🌐 = global (land & ocean), 🌿 = land surfaces and coastal areas only, 🎯 = tasked/on-demand. <sup>\*</sup> The failure of Sentinel-1B induced significant data gaps, see [Appendix: Sentinel-1 data gaps](appendix_s1_gaps.qmd). <sup>†</sup> Gaofen-1/6 is openly distributed at Level 1 only: published ARD covers only China and its surrounding areas. <sup>‡</sup> The Dove constellation provides near-daily coverage of the land surface; sub-daily revisit of a specific site requires tasking a different constellation. {#tbl-eo-missions}
